text.p: Schedule for the 1999 World Cup cricket tournament announced at Lord's on Tuesday:
Group A - England, India, Kenya, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Zimbabwe
Group B - Australia, Bangladesh, New Zealand, Pakistan, Scotland, West Indies

May 14 - England v Sri Lanka, Lord's
May 15 - India v South Africa, Hove
Zimbabwe v Kenya, Taunton
May 16 - Australia v Scotland, Worcester
West Indies v Pakistan, Bristol

India v Zimbabwe, Leicester
May 20 - Australia v New Zealand, Cardiff
Pakistan v Scotland, Chester-Le-Street
May 21 - West Indies v Bangladesh, Ireland (venue TBA)
May 22 - England v South Africa, The Oval
Zimbabwe v Sri Lanka, Worcester
